def _native(screen):
    return re.search(r'^\S+ connected(?:\s|$)',screen,re.M) is not None

def _root_size(screen):
    match=re.search(r'\bcurrent (\d+) x (\d+),',screen)
    return tuple(map(int,match.groups())) if match else None

def _monitor():
    monitors=command(['xrandr','--listmonitors']).stdout
    match=re.search(r'^\s*\d+:\s+[+*]*AXL-ESP32\s+(\S+)',monitors,re.M)
    return match.group(1) if match else None

def _geometry(size):
    w,h=size
    return f'{w}/{round(w*25.4/96)}x{h}/{round(h*25.4/96)}+0+0'

def _set_monitor(current,wanted):
    if current==wanted:return
    if current is not None:command(['xrandr','--delmonitor','AXL-ESP32'])
    if wanted is not None:command(['xrandr','--setmonitor','AXL-ESP32',wanted,'none'])

def _recover_wired():
    """The root window outlives the broker, but belongs to this X session only."""
    global _wired_recovered,_wired_previous
    if _wired_recovered:return
    value=command(['xprop','-root',_RESTORE_PROPERTY]).stdout.strip()
    if '=' in value:
        match=re.fullmatch(re.escape(_RESTORE_PROPERTY)+
            rf'\(STRING\) = "(\d+) (\d+) (-|{_MONITOR_GEOMETRY}) ([01])"',value)
        if not match:raise ValueError('Unknown wired display recovery record')
        w,h=map(int,match.group(1,2))
        if not (1<=w<=8192 and 1<=h<=8192):raise ValueError('Invalid saved desktop geometry')
        monitor=match.group(3)
        _wired_previous=((w,h),None if monitor=='-' else monitor,match.group(4)=='1')
    _wired_recovered=True

def _remember_wired(size,monitor):
    global _wired_previous
    if monitor is not None and not re.fullmatch(_MONITOR_GEOMETRY,monitor):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported logical monitor geometry')
    saved=f'{size[0]} {size[1]} {monitor or "-"} {int(_active)}'
    command(['xprop','-root','-f',_RESTORE_PROPERTY,'8s','-set',_RESTORE_PROPERTY,saved])
    _wired_previous=(size,monitor,_active)

def _restore_wired(screen=None):
    """Restore our last headless modeset only while its geometry is still present."""
    global _wired_previous,_checked,_size,_active
    if _wired_previous is None:return
    if screen is None:screen=command(['xrandr','--current']).stdout
    size,monitor,was_active=_wired_previous
    root=_root_size(screen)
    current=_monitor()
    wired_monitor=_geometry(WIRED_SIZE)
    if _native(screen):
        if current==wired_monitor and monitor!=wired_monitor:_set_monitor(current,None)
        was_active=False
    elif root in (WIRED_SIZE,size) and current in (wired_monitor,monitor,None):
        if root!=size:command(['xrandr','--fb',f'{size[0]}x{size[1]}'])
        _set_monitor(current,monitor)
    else:
        # Another display manager took over after the wired geometry was set.
        was_active=False
    command(['xprop','-root','-remove',_RESTORE_PROPERTY])
    _wired_previous=None
    _size=size if was_active else None
    _active=was_active
    _checked=0.0

def ensure_wired_size():
    """Called only from the guarded paired capture. Hold one shared desktop geometry."""
    global _wired_until,_wired_check,_size,_active,_opened
    with _lock:
        now=time.monotonic()
        _wired_until=now+4.0
        if now<_wired_check:return
        _wired_check=now+1.0
        try:
            _recover_wired()
            screen=command(['xrandr','--current']).stdout
            if _native(screen):
                _restore_wired(screen)
                _active=False
                return
            size=_root_size(screen)
            if size is None or not all(1<=n<=8192 for n in size):return
            monitor=_monitor()
            if _wired_previous is None:_remember_wired(size,monitor)
            if size!=WIRED_SIZE:command(['xrandr','--fb',f'{WIRED_SIZE[0]}x{WIRED_SIZE[1]}'])
            _set_monitor(monitor,_geometry(WIRED_SIZE))
            _size=WIRED_SIZE
            _active=True
            if not _opened:launch('apps');_opened=True
        except (OSError,ValueError,subprocess.SubprocessError):
            # Unsupported headless modes still show the full desktop through fit_frame.
            _wired_check=now+10.0
            _restore_wired()

def release_idle_wired():
    with _lock:
        _recover_wired()
        if time.monotonic()>=_wired_until:_restore_wired()
